vision: A 9-stage pipeline that pre-analyzes ITSM change requests for CAB meetings, working with real-world incomplete data from day one. Treats missing artifacts as findings, not errors. Validates against BPI Challenge 2014 real ITIL change records from Rabobank.
direction: Python 3.12+, Pydantic v2, sequential pipeline with disk checkpoints. Real-first data strategy: BPI 2014 as primary dataset, synthetic fixtures as regression tests. All stages at L1 (script-only, $0 LLM). Graceful degradation: stages skip or degrade when input artifacts are missing.

trade_offs.decision: Real-first with BPI 2014 instead of synthetic-first
trade_offs.reasoning: Real data grounds the pipeline in actual ITSM patterns. Synthetic data follows ITIL templates by construction and is too clean. Starting with real data forces graceful degradation from day one.

trade_offs.decision: Pipeline accepts partial CR bundles (only itsm_record required)
trade_offs.alternative: Require all 7 mandatory artifacts as originally designed
trade_offs.reasoning: Real-world CRs are incomplete. No public dataset has runbooks or rollback plans. Enterprise data is also often incomplete. Partial acceptance is both realistic and necessary for real-data validation.

trade_offs.decision: Spike on BPI 2014 before finalizing schema changes
trade_offs.alternative: Finalize schemas first based on ARCHITECTURE.md design
trade_offs.reasoning: Schema changes depend on understanding what fields actually exist in the real data. Designing schemas before exploring data risks rework.

open_questions: [RESOLVED] BPI 2014: 21 cols, semicolon CSV, multi-CI per change, 18K unique changes. See .harness/spike-bpi2014.md
[RESOLVED] CAB windows: filter CAB-approval needed=Y, group by ISO week → 51 windows, 1-21 changes each
[RESOLVED] GT: 56 (CI, ChangeType) tuples with >=2 incidents → natural ground truth for Historical Pattern
How to map 240 Change Types to standard/normal/emergency? Pattern: Standard*→standard, Release*→normal, Emergency flag→emergency
CI Name vs Service Component WBS as service identifier? WBS=286 groups (service-level), CI Name=10K individual items
Co-occurrence graph for Stage 7: 25K overlaps exist but co-occurrence != dependency. Worth implementing or just skip?

[PENDING] Define MVP scope: which of the 9 stages are in-scope for MVP? BPI 2014 supports 5 well (Ingest, Normalize, Completeness, Schedule overlap, Historical Pattern). Stages 4/5/7 have no data, SLA math has 97% missing. Also: what output format for MVP (JSON only vs JSON+Markdown report)?
